title: A multi-nutrient nanocomposite enhances UV stress tolerance and modulates nutrient accumulation in lettuce
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,3089-3108
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00154D, Paper
Raja muthuramalingam Thangavelu, Washington da Silva, Jose A. Hernandez-Viezcas, Vinka Oyanedel-Craver, Jorge L. Gardea-Torresdey, Christian O. Dimkpa, Jason C. White, Nubia Zuverza Mena
This study introduces a novel multielement (Zn–Mg–Mn–Fe) nanocomposite that serves both as a UV-protective agent and a nutrient delivery system for Lactuca sativa (lettuce). Graphical abstract image created with BioRender.com.
